_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta hunga Golf (Wega di Carta) - Player {player_id}.
Meta: Haya e puntuacion total mas abao den e rondo aki. Si columnanan ta comparti mesun valor, nan ta suma como 0.
Valor di Cartanan: A=1, 2-10=valor di cara, J/Q=10, K=0

Accionnan (usá parentesis exacto):
- '[draw]' - Sacá for di baraha
- '[take]' - Tuma for di pila di descarta
- '[swap X Y]' - Cambia carta sacá cu position X (fila) Y (columna)
- '[discard]' - Descarta e carta sacá

board.drew:
Bo a saca: {card}
Awo bo mester [swap X Y] o [discard]
board.took: Bo a tuma: {card} for di e pila di deskarga. Bo mester [swap X Y] ku esaki (no por kita).

options.final_turns: Turnonan final! Opcionnan di bo: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Bo mester: [swap X Y] (no por kita karchinan for di e pila pa tira)

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} a cambia {new} cu {old} na position ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: E palu ta bashí! Wegua ta kaba mesora.
message.knocked: E hungadó {pid} a keda knock! Kada otro hungadó ta haña un turno mas.
message.final_round: Hungadó {pid} {reason}! Kada otro hungadó ta haña un rònt mas.

invalid.wrong_action: Usá EXACTAMENTE UN accion entre parentesis: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: E pila di deskarga ta bashí!
invalid.must_draw_first: Bo mester prome [draw], [take], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Bo no por kita un karta ku bo a saka for di e pila, sino kambia.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Bo tin un karchi di sorteo. Abo mester [swap X Y] òf [discard] e.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Bo mester di un karta ku ta ser trese pa bo por interkambiá.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Bo mester di un karta ku bo a saka pa kita.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Position fuera di limites. Usá fila 1-{max_row}, columna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Bo no por bati na porta ku un karta di karchi. Kompleta bo turno promé.
invalid.already_knocked: Algu a dal ya un knock den e ronda aki.
invalid.already_revealed: E karta ei ya ta revelá!
